title: Root-cause analysis with corrective-action tracking
description: Uses 5-whys and fishbone analysis to identify root causes and track verified corrective actions.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: root-cause-corrective-actions
  title: Root-cause analysis with corrective-action tracking
  description: Uses 5-whys and fishbone analysis to identify root causes and track verified corrective actions.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Eliminate or reduce recurrence through evidence-based corrective action.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - problem-owner
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Problem statement and evidence
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - incident
          - evidence
          - scope
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: investigate
      kind: agent
      name: Analyze causal factors
      role: Root-cause facilitator
      prompt: Build 5-whys and fishbone analyses. Distinguish evidence, hypotheses, contributing factors, and root causes.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: actions
      kind: agent
      name: Define corrective actions
      role: Corrective action manager
      prompt: Create preventive and corrective actions with owners, due dates, verification criteria, and risk of side effects.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: verify
      kind: loop
      name: Verify action effectiveness
      config:
        body:
          - investigate
          - actions
        exitCondition: actions.effectivenessVerified == true
        maxIterations: 2
        onExhausted: warn
    - id: problem-owner
      kind: approval
      name: Problem owner accepts RCA and actions
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: RCA record and corrective-action tracker
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: investigate
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: investigate
      to: actions
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: actions
      to: verify
      kind: dependency
    - id: e4
      from: verify
      to: problem-owner
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: e5
      from: problem-owner
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
    - id: verify-exhausted
      from: verify
      to: problem-owner
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exhausted
